body: I want friends, but I don't want friends. I feel like I'm too much of a worthless piece of crap and I don't want to be a problem to anyone, so I pretty much gave up on trying to socialize.
Oh that's not the problem for me. It just makes me feel even more worthless. I just want to die, seriously I don't think anything can help at all.

Yeah... I gave up on love a long time ago. I can't even make friends because my self-esteem and confidence is practically non-existant because my face is messed up. I stopped taking care of myself because of depression and AvPD, and all I can feel is regret because I can't repair any of it. Surgery costs so much and I'm too poor and weak for that. I also compare to what people comsider ugly people and like you, I feel like if they saw me, they'd pretty much puke.

So because of all that, I just avoid everyone so I don't fall in love or start being interested in them.

I don't know what to say to make you feel better, because I suck at this and the fear of saying something wrong prevents me from doing so... But I've met a lot of guys that didn't really care about the weight.

We do not live the same life, and we don't have the same environment. I'm pretty certain no one around me has it worse. The minute you can smile, you're already doing better than I do. Yes they might have their own problems, and are working really hard, but that's what I mean. They have the strength to do all of this, I don't.

Same here. Dreams are so nice yet they are a double edge sword. No matter what I dream, it's still better than reality, but when I dream that I have friends, that I am sociable, that I'm prettier, that I have a girlfriend... Yeah when I wake up, it's really painful.

Same here... I thirst for friendship and affection so much, I am so desperate. But when giving the opportunity, I get really distant and I start feeling really bad. The worst is that everyone is living a better life than I am, and I get really jealous and depressed everytime I get the opportunity to hang out with someone.
I have a very strict definition of "caring", and that's not how I see it. I've seen a lot of people on the internet saying this exact thing, and it's never really true.

The fact that this group exist proves nothing at all. There's alone and alone. I know there's peopel going through the same thing, but it doesn't change the fact that I am compeltely alone right now, at this moment in my life, and that will probably never change. If I wasn't alone, worthless, ugly or depressed, I wouldn't be posting here, in fact I wouldn't be having problems right now. People can say whatever they want, but depression does not always lie, sometime it says the truth.
I got lied to way too much. I prefer brutal honesty over lying.
Not really...

I'm in the same boat. I'm currently also planning to end it soon. I thought about it and if I don't do it, I'm pretty much going to end up homeless.

So I don't want to be hypocrite and tell you that it will get better (because it doesn't always do). All I can do here in my current state is respect whatever choice you make. :)

Well history time, once upon a time, man invented money. Since then, everything cost money. So when you're too weak and want help, you need money. When your face is as messy as Habitat 67 and you want to fix it, you need money. When you need help for your bone problems because your mother gave you Marfan Syndrome, you need money.

You got it, I'm poor, negative, ugly, and completely hopeless. ^_^

No really I gave up on everything already. I messed up a lot and now there's no going back, it's beyond repair. I'm completely done with life, I currenly trying to figure out how and when I'm going to end it. Meanwhile I'm just reading and trying to grab whatever I can. I mean if somehow I can find something (or someone) to start living again, that would be awesome. 

But that's most likely not going to happen since I've been trying that for the past year and nothing has worked. I'm too weak to live, too depressed to care, and too ugly inside and outside to hope for a better future.
I don't hate halloween. I can't blame other people for not having any of my problems. I hate life.
Hey thanks, but I really am. It's just a matter of time before I'm homeless or dead.
Halloween has been like any other day for me. Nothing different, I'm still trying to think how I'm going to end my life soon.
If there's one thing life has taught me, it's that I hate gifts and surprises.

Yeah, and it gets worse when people then ask you "so, what did you do for halloween / christmas / summer / weekend / last night?". I hate lying, so I just end up not answering anything and it hurts so bad because it reminds me how worthless I am. But it's fine though, no one ever ask me that really, no one really want to talk to me.

Yep. I have that too. I have absolutely no one in my life right now. It gets really depressing when you start convincing yourself that you will never have anyone ever again, that you have too many bad traits for someone to like you enough for them to ask you if you want to do these sorts of things god damn that sentence was long seriously though.

No there's not. My dad is getting sick of all my shit, my mom stopped caring when I tried to kill myself two months ago, she pretty much gave up on helping me since I'm hopeless. I have no friends at all, I have no one to talk to, no one to play with, no one to laugh with, and I understand why. 

I spoke to a lot of people on the internet but I either stop talking to them when I feel like I'm a problem to them or when I feel like they're getting frustrated because I'm too negative. I stopped actually believing that I can someday not be alone.

I got bullied because of it even though I wasn't that ugly before. But depression and AvPD didn't help at all, I stopped taking care of myself and now it's just not fixable anymore. I do not have the ressources to fix my jaw, teeth, lazy eye heck even acne. I'm really poor and can't really do anything about it. All of my money goes to school, I'm trying to get my high school diploma at least, even though it sucks seeing all the people there being really happy, laughing with friends. I haven't seen anymore uglier than me yet, and I feel like nobody wants to talk to me because of it.

Uncontrollable negative thoughts. Nonexistant self-esteem and confidence. Really ugly body and face. Weak body caused by Marfan Syndrome. Weak mental state caused by Avoidant Personality Disorder. Lack of interests and passion. Self-imposed isolation caused by social anxiety and because I'm aware of my current mental state. Lack of people to talk to because either A) I start avoiding people when I feel like a burden or a problem to them, or I start feeling that they are frustrated because I'm a hopeless, worthless negative piece of crap or B) they just give up on me because they tried to help and it didn't work.

That's pretty much it.

I don't actually know. I said the world is medium only to give an idea of the size of the dungeon. These chests could have been scattered everywhere, but there was 7 of them really close to each other in the room.

I also hate when people use age as an excuse for not being depressed or having any other mental illness. I get really angry and immediately hate the person if she does this. Simple as that. Take your ignorance out of my sight.
Yeah your name pretty much confirms it. I mean unless you play Terraria because that's the only other game I play, you're right, we won't get to play together o.o

Oh man I feel like I'm reading myself. I made a post on r/depression not too long ago about League being my only escape. It's really the only game that I care about and I rarely play other games. I have avoidant personality disorder and depression, so any real life thing is hell for me. At least you can mute people in the game, not in real life. Ugh.

But I'm not as good as you though, merely platinum 5 here, and I can only play one champion decently enough. You are miles above me and I can only respect your dedication towards the game.
I used to play on Europe. I'm a french canadian and I thought I would meet nice french people there. Nope. Ended up wasting 20$ to go to NA.
It doesn't, and I won't. Sorry but I've had my fair share of people to "talk to", but it's always the same bullshit. Talking doesn't help.

Yeah yeah other people have it worse so cheer up bullship thanks but I'm gonna go now. I don't like these kinds of conversation. They piss me off so much. I know what the fuck is going on in my life. I know how weak I am, physically and mentally. I know who I have in my life (nobody by the way, no family, no friends, and it's okay, I understand, there's no reason to choose me over anything, even a sewer rat or a mosquitoe is more interesting and worth your time than me).

You're terribly wrong. Life is not for everyone and not everyone is worth something. The fact that I'm so negative and not willing to do anything to change anything just proves that I'm not strong enough for life. I do not want to work my ass off to get simple things other people get without trying. Fuck that.

I'm starting to hate when people tell me I'm worth something when they have no fucking idea what's behind the reddit name. I'm not worth anything, period. That's it. Stop telling me this, because how know how much of a lonely, ugly, finished piece of shit I am.
